findings.title: Persist failure aborts remaining member reset loop
findings.problem: _persist_child_budget_provider_state (line 1353) and update_provider_metadata (line 1358) are outside the try/except that guards reset_project_member_spending. A DB exception at either persist point propagates uncaught and terminates the allocation for-loop early.
findings.impact: Allocations not yet reached in the loop are never reset in LiteLLM and their DB records are not updated. No warning is emitted for those skipped members, making the failure invisible in monitoring and leaving the reset silently partial.
findings.recommendation: Wrap lines 1353-1369 in a separate try/except that catches, logs with budget_event=project_member_persist_failed, and continues to the next allocation — mirroring the guard already applied to the reset step at lines 1341-1352.
